bocpd.horizonMeaning: Signal heuristic, not a fixed holding deadline or calibrated executable net-return forecast
bocpd.bandMeaning: Base round-trip cost remains fixed in all execution stresses
bocpd.inference: Full run-length bank, no truncation; forward filtering only; no future smoothing
bocpd.risk: Unlevered funded long/cash; common replay entry ceiling applies; no enforced stop or drawdown halt

hmm.candidate: HMM-inspired trading rule using an established Gaussian hidden Markov model; expected log-growth proxy, not validated expected cash profit.
hmm.trainingScope: First 90 close-to-close log returns only; parameters frozen thereafter. Batch forward/backward fitting is confined to this already observed initial window.
hmm.quantileConvention: Nearest-rank sorted training return at ceil(q*N)-1.
hmm.initialVariance: Population variance of the 90 training returns, floored at minimumVariance.
hmm.emissionPseudoVariance: Global population training variance, with same floor.
hmm.regularization: Each state receives five virtual Gaussian observations with mean zero and variance equal to global training variance: mu=sum(gamma*r)/(sum(gamma)+5); var=(sum(gamma*(r-mu)^2)+5*(globalVariance+mu^2))/(sum(gamma)+5). Transition counts receive declared pseudocounts. These are regularized EM updates, not unpenalized maximum-likelihood EM.
hmm.stateOrdering: Sort final states by fitted mean and permute transition rows/columns. Initial state probabilities remain uniform.
hmm.decision: Cash before the first 90 returns are observed. Thereafter enter ETH if forecast > entryLogHurdle; exit if forecast <= 0; retain previous target in between.
hmm.execution: Root evaluator supplies delayed funded fills, liquidation accounting and costs; this module emits targets only and never orders. Signal cost reference stays fixed across root execution scenarios.
hmm.trainingInitialization: Deterministic; no random restarts or alternate initializations.
hmm.dataReuse: Historical dates have been used in prior studies; any replay remains exploratory.

priorControl.status: previously selected; not a new method

account: Each reset window and separate continuous run starts with $10000. Entry=min($1000,10% current equity,cash,past-volume ceiling), fee-inclusive. One funded long or cash. No additions, leverage, enforced stop/drawdown halt or current-runtime parity.
execution: Finalized daily bar i targets fill at open i+2/base or i+3/delay. Terminal flatten pays adverse price and fees at last close. OHLC proxy, not proven executable liquidity.
selection: Select between the two new prototypes using worst-scenario development net minus half close drawdown; ties lexicographic. No later reselection.
nomination: All12 reset-window/scenario nets positive, >=10 total later episodes per scenario, maximum later low drawdown <=500. Historical proxy nomination only, never proof.
limitations: Two researched and implemented mechanisms are not 10000 original mathematical systems.
Both model-to-trade rules are new research heuristics, not profit guarantees from source papers.
Horizon forecasts do not impose a holding deadline and are not calibrated episode profit predictions.
Current public fee assumptions, no authenticated actual fee verification.
Known history and small samples prevent untouched validation claims.
Forecaster mechanisms and economic-system mechanisms are separate taxonomy axes; do not add their counts.
